I need to calculate 50! (50 factorial) and then sum all of its decimal digits.

```python
import math

# Calculate 50!
factorial_50 = math.factorial(50)
print(f"50! = {factorial_50}")

# Sum all decimal digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(factorial_50))
print(f"Sum of digits of 50!: {digit_sum}")

ANSWER: {digit_sum}
```
